about_the_game:
"Detective Support - Grow a Carrot" is a DLC for "Grow a Carrot" in style of a visual novel with minigames! Explore bizzare lore of bunny island! Meet your favourite bunnies! Get to know who you are...




The DLC is divided into 9 short chapters with dialogues, each ending with a minigame. The entire DLC is in a point-and-click style, and offers approximately 30 minutes of gameplay.



Created in a pixel-art style with jazz playing in the background, it is designed to help you relax. "Detective Support - Grow a Carrot" DLC focuses mainly on the lore of Bunny Island and the player's backstory.

You wake up on Bunny Island, where Detective Support finds you. You go on an adventure across the island, uncovering the truth behind this mysterious place.

After finishing the DLC, you'll unlock chapter select, allowing you to replay your favorite chapter or re-read it if you missed something.
